questions.question: Which country did MS Dhoni make his international debut against in December 2004?
questions.explanation: Dhoni made his ODI debut on December 23, 2004 vs Bangladesh at MA Aziz Stadium, Chattogram.

questions.question: Before breaking into international cricket, at which railway station did MS Dhoni work as a Train Ticket Examiner (TTE)?
questions.explanation: Dhoni worked as a Traveling Ticket Examiner (TTE) at Kharagpur railway station in West Bengal from 2001 to 2003.

questions.question: Which state did MS Dhoni represent when he made his Ranji Trophy debut in the 1999–2000 season?
questions.explanation: Dhoni made his first-class Ranji Trophy debut for Bihar in the 1999–2000 season (before Jharkhand was carved out as a separate state).

questions.question: In which domestic tournament for India A in Kenya (2004) did Dhoni smash multiple centuries to earn his national call-up?
questions.explanation: Dhoni scored 362 runs in 6 innings with two centuries against Pakistan A and Kenya in the 2004 Kenya Tri-Series.

questions.question: How was MS Dhoni dismissed on his international debut match against Bangladesh in 2004?
questions.explanation: Dhoni was unfortunately run out for a golden duck (0 off 1 ball) in his debut ODI on December 23, 2004.

questions.question: Who was India's regular captain who backed young MS Dhoni during his initial 2004-2005 international appearances?
questions.explanation: Captain Sourav Ganguly recognized Dhoni's raw power and famously surrendered his own No. 3 batting position for him.

questions.question: Against which team did MS Dhoni score his career-highest ODI score of 183* (145 balls) in 2005?
questions.explanation: Scored at Sawai Mansingh Stadium, Jaipur on October 31, 2005 — the highest individual ODI score by a wicketkeeper in history.

questions.question: In which city did MS Dhoni smash his maiden international century (148 off 123 balls) against Pakistan in April 2005?
questions.explanation: Dhoni announced himself to the world with a blistering 148 off 123 balls (15 fours, 4 sixes) in Vizag on April 5, 2005.

questions.question: How many sixes did MS Dhoni smash during his immortal 183* innings against Sri Lanka in Jaipur (2005)?
questions.explanation: Dhoni blasted 10 sixes and 15 boundaries in his iconic 183* off 145 balls to chase down 299 with 23 balls to spare.

questions.question: Where did MS Dhoni score his maiden Test century (148 off 153 balls) in January 2006?
questions.explanation: Dhoni scored his maiden Test century (148 off 153 balls) with breathtaking counter-attacking strokes in Faisalabad, Pakistan in 2006.

questions.question: In how many innings from his debut did MS Dhoni claim the ICC World No. 1 ODI Batsman ranking in April 2006 (a world record)?
questions.explanation: Dhoni reached the No. 1 spot in the ICC ODI Batting Rankings in just 42 innings, the fastest in cricket history.

questions.question: What was MS Dhoni's career-highest individual score in Test match cricket (scored vs Australia in Chennai, 2013)?
questions.explanation: Dhoni hit a dominant 224 off 265 balls at Chepauk in February 2013, the highest Test score by an Indian wicketkeeper.

questions.question: In the 2016 T20 World Cup 1-run thriller in Bengaluru, whom did Dhoni run out on the final ball after sprinting 25m with his glove off?
questions.explanation: Dhoni took off his right glove beforehand, sprinted like a sprinter, and broke the stumps by inches to seal an unbelievable 1-run win.

questions.question: What is the all-time world record number of international stumpings held exclusively by MS Dhoni?
questions.explanation: Dhoni holds the world record for the most stumpings in international cricket: 195 (123 ODI, 38 Test, 34 T20I).

questions.question: What is MS Dhoni's record fastest recorded stumping reaction time, measured by broadcast telemetry?
questions.explanation: Dhoni stumped West Indies' Keemo Paul in just 0.08 seconds (faster than the blink of a human eye at 0.10s).

questions.question: How many total dismissals (catches + stumpings) did MS Dhoni complete across all international cricket?
questions.explanation: Dhoni finished with 829 international dismissals (634 catches, 195 stumpings), ranking 3rd in all-time world cricket history.

questions.question: Which trademark wicketkeeping innovation is Dhoni famous for creating to effect run-outs without looking at the stumps?
questions.explanation: Dhoni pioneered the blind deflection/no-look back flick between his legs directly onto the stumps without turning his head.

questions.question: How many dismissals did MS Dhoni effect in a single Test match against Australia at Melbourne in 2014?
questions.explanation: Dhoni took 8 catches and 1 stumping (9 dismissals) in his final Test match at the Melbourne Cricket Ground in December 2014.

levelName: Stage 4: The Mind (2007 T20 World Cup & Leadership)

questions.question: Whom did MS Dhoni hand the ball to for the final over of the 2007 ICC World Twenty20 Final in Johannesburg?
questions.explanation: Joginder Sharma dismissed Misbah-ul-Haq (caught by Sreesanth at short fine-leg) to win India the inaugural T20 World Cup.

questions.question: In the famous 2007 T20 World Cup bowl-out against Pakistan, which non-regular bowler did Dhoni pick to hit the stumps?
questions.explanation: Dhoni picked Sehwag, Harbhajan, and Uthappa (who had practiced aim), and crouched right behind the stumps to give them a direct target.

questions.question: In which year did MS Dhoni lead India to the historic CB Tri-Series triumph on Australian soil against Ricky Ponting's Australia?
questions.explanation: Dhoni led a young Indian squad to a historic 2-0 finals victory over Australia in the best-of-three Commonwealth Bank Series in March 2008.

questions.question: How many total international matches did MS Dhoni captain Team India across Test, ODI, and T20I cricket (a world record)?
questions.explanation: Dhoni captained India in an astonishing 332 international matches (60 Tests, 200 ODIs, 72 T20Is) — the most by any captain in cricket history.

questions.question: In the 2008 CB Series final, what famous instruction did Dhoni give to his teammates when hitting the winning runs?
options: No wild celebrations on the balcony
questions.correctAnswer: No wild celebrations on the balcony
questions.explanation: Dhoni ordered no excessive balcony celebrations to show the world and Australia that winning against them was not a fluke, but the new standard.

questions.question: Against which country did MS Dhoni captain India for the very first time in an international game in 2006?
questions.explanation: Dhoni led India in their first-ever T20I match vs South Africa at Johannesburg on December 1, 2006.

levelName: Stage 5: The Calm (2011 World Cup & The Finisher Engine)

questions.question: In the iconic 2011 ICC Cricket World Cup Final at Wankhede, whom did MS Dhoni promote himself ahead of in the batting order?
questions.explanation: Dhoni promoted himself to No. 5 to face Sri Lanka's Muttiah Muralitharan and scored 91* to win Player of the Match.

questions.question: Which Sri Lankan fast bowler did MS Dhoni hit for the immortal match-winning six over long-on in the 2011 World Cup Final?
questions.explanation: Dhoni lofted Nuwan Kulasekara high over long-on into the Wankhede crowd to seal India's second ODI World Cup.

questions.question: What is MS Dhoni's staggering career batting average in successful ODI run-chases for Team India?
questions.explanation: In 116 successful ODI run-chases, Dhoni scored 2,876 runs with an astronomical average of 102.71 and 47 not outs.

questions.question: How many times did MS Dhoni finish an ODI match for India by hitting a six on the final or penultimate ball?
questions.explanation: Dhoni sealed victory for India with a six on 9 distinct occasions in ODI cricket history.

questions.question: In Dharamsala IPL 2010 vs Kings XI Punjab, CSK needed 16 runs in the final over from Irfan Pathan. How did Dhoni finish it?
questions.explanation: Dhoni blasted 4, 2, 6, 6 to score 54* (29) and punched his helmet in an ultra-rare display of raw emotion to send CSK to the semi-finals.

questions.question: In the Celkon Mobile Cup Tri-Series Final (2013) in Port of Spain vs Sri Lanka, how many runs did Dhoni score in the final over off Shaminda Eranga to win the trophy?
questions.explanation: With India 9 wickets down needing 15 off the last over, Dhoni hit 0, 6, 4, 6 to claim the trophy from the jaws of defeat.

levelName: Stage 6: The Trifecta (2013 Champions Trophy & Test #1)

questions.question: MS Dhoni completed the unprecedented ICC White-Ball Trophy Trifecta by winning the 2013 Champions Trophy in which English city?
questions.explanation: India defended a low total of 129 in a rain-reduced 20-over final against England at Edgbaston, Birmingham.

questions.question: In the 2013 Champions Trophy Final, which bowler did Dhoni bring back in the 18th over to dismiss Eoin Morgan and Ravi Bopara on consecutive balls?
questions.explanation: Despite going for runs earlier, Dhoni backed Ishant Sharma for the 18th over, who struck twice in two balls to turn the final on its head.

questions.question: Under MS Dhoni's captaincy, in which year did Team India achieve the ICC Test Championship No. 1 ranking (Test Mace) for the first time in history?
questions.explanation: India defeated Sri Lanka 2-0 at Brabourne Stadium in December 2009 to claim the #1 ICC Test ranking for the first time.

questions.question: How many total ICC Trophies did MS Dhoni win as India captain during his international career?
questions.explanation: Dhoni won the 2007 T20 World Cup, 2011 Cricket World Cup, and 2013 Champions Trophy (the only captain to win all three).

questions.question: Who bowled the tense final over of the 2013 Champions Trophy Final at Edgbaston where England needed 15 runs to win?
questions.explanation: Ashwin bowled a magical final over, conceding just 9 runs and beating James Tredwell on the last ball as Dhoni jumped in delight.

questions.question: In which city did MS Dhoni play his 90th and final Test match in December 2014 before retiring from Test cricket?
questions.explanation: Dhoni retired from Test cricket on December 30, 2014 immediately following the drawn Boxing Day Test at Melbourne.

levelName: Stage 7: Yellow Kingdom (5x IPL & 07 Mahi Legend)

questions.question: In the dramatic 3:00 AM rain-affected IPL 2023 Final in Ahmedabad, how many runs did CSK need off the final 2 balls before Jadeja hit a 6 and 4?
questions.explanation: CSK needed 10 runs off 2 balls from Mohit Sharma; Ravindra Jadeja hit a straight 6 followed by a fine-leg 4 to seal CSK's 5th title!

questions.question: How many IPL titles and Champions League T20 (CLT20) titles has MS Dhoni won as captain of Chennai Super Kings (CSK)?
questions.explanation: Dhoni led CSK to 5 IPL titles (2010, 2011, 2018, 2021, 2023) and 2 CLT20 titles (2010, 2014) — matching his iconic jersey number 7!

questions.question: What was MS Dhoni's highest individual score in the Indian Premier League (IPL)?
questions.explanation: Dhoni blasted an unbelievable 84* off 48 balls with 7 sixes and 5 fours vs RCB in 2019 at Chinnaswamy, nearly pulling off a miraculous 26-run final over chase.

questions.question: In IPL 2018 at the Chinnaswamy Stadium, CSK chased 206 against RCB. With how many balls to spare did Dhoni hit Corey Anderson for the match-winning six (70* off 34)?
questions.explanation: Dhoni smashed a majestic wide-swinging six over wide long-on off Corey Anderson with 2 balls remaining to finish on 70* (34).

questions.question: In how many IPL Finals has MS Dhoni appeared as a player and captain (an all-time IPL record)?
questions.explanation: Dhoni has played in a record 11 IPL Finals (10 with CSK in 2008, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2015, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2023 and 1 with RPSG in 2017).

questions.question: Against Mumbai Indians at Wankhede in IPL 2024, how many runs did MS Dhoni score in the final 4 balls of the 20th over off Hardik Pandya?
questions.explanation: Dhoni came out in the 20th over and smashed Hardik Pandya for a hat-trick of sixes (6, 6, 6) and 2 runs to finish 20* off 4 balls — the exact 20-run margin CSK won by!
